title: Trace of sigma_i
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly show that Tr(sigma_i) = 0.

title: Eigenvalues of sigma_i
description: Essential Criteria - The student must demonstrate that the eigenvalues of sigma_i are ±1.

title: Determinant of sigma_i
description: Essential Criteria - The student must conclude that det(sigma_i) = -1.

title: Linear Independence
description: Important Criteria - The student must provide a valid argument showing that the matrices I, sigma_i are linearly independent.

title: Expression for m_i
description: Important Criteria - The student must derive the correct expressions for m_0 and m_i.

title: Trace Calculation
description: Optional Criteria - The student may include the calculation of Tr(M) to find m_0.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should check that units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the trace calculations.
